 Previously selected ghost is now saved to the next map. ( the nth entry )
 Loading icon UI, when downloading new ghost.
 Tutorial text UI. ( can be opened with the key 'I' or from the pause menu by pressing 'HELP' )

 Camera start position tweak.
 Door shut sound is now directional.
 Edited the decorations of some maps.
 Some optimization.

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42880136/7e6dabc1a8a90930ec6a8d2814e695585650129c.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42880136/52c771646da6a22cc40adebc9529d5050356c31d.png

 Updated which maps are in the DEMO.
 You can now see both global and friends leaderboard, at the end of the map.
 9 new hats added for future rewards.
 Changed default next map hotkey to the 'E' key.
 Changed default previous map hotkey to the 'Q' key.
 You can take screenshots by pressing 'F12'.
 Re-imported more higher quality textures.
 Jump PB now saves and shows correctly.
 Added UI in the Character menu for claiming reward hats in the future.
 Improved fps by removing useless shadow casters and lights from some maps.

 Added 'Character' menu:
 	- You can choose which, unlocked, character you want to play as.
 	- You can choose which, unlocked, hat you want your character to wear.
	          * Only the hats you can unlock in the demo are shown.

 2 new achievements added:
 	- Unlock the Pyramid hat.
 	- Unlock the Temple hat.

 Your leaderboard, score and rank, now shows on the map selection menu.

 Updated the map completion UI.

 Re-imported a huge amount of textures, to make them higher quality.

 A massive amount of smaller bug fixes and cleanup.
